Publish.LongDescription:
# Extended Tooltip
This mod adds new information to the mouse hover tooltip of several entities to the game. If you want anything added to the tooltip, please let me know and open an issue.
## Important Note This mod is originally created by **89pleasure**. He has given me permission to maintain and continue development on this mod.
## Current features Shows the following information on tooltips: - Efficiency - Employees - Company produces/sells information - Citizen: Status, Happiness, State, Education, ect. - Schools: Students current/max - Public Transport: Waiting passengers, Average waiting time - Roads: Length, Upkeep, Conditions - Zones: Zone info, Households, Residents, Pets, Rent, Balance ect. - Vehicles: Driver, Passengers, Garbage Trucks info, Postvan info - many more
## Credit Thanks to TDW for their efforts to migrate this mod and apply various improvements.
Publish.ChangeLog: - Added Vehicle Properties Tooltip (disabled by default, advanced settings) - Updated all localizations and remove unneeded localization (using LLM, feel free to provide updated localizations to the GitHub) - Fixed a bug where the Net Tool Unit setting would not be remembered - Fixed a bug where the company balance tooltip showed the wrong value - Fixed bug where public transport stops with parking didn't show bus stop info, just parking info - Fixed several issues where tooltips would not show all values - Added Layout Balancing for Extended Layout, so that both sides display a similar number of tooltips - TODO: Add Tooltip for healthcare usage (50%, 100/200 patients), cemetary and garbage
